The '''Corporate Period''' was an era on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] when the world was still controlled by the [[Bakur Mining Corporation]]. During this time, [[Dif Istuvi]] led the faithful of the [[Cosmic Balance]] on Bakura.
